name: Oligochaete worms & leeches
description: Segmented worms of the sediment and their predatory relatives the leeches. Functional group pooling the source's two annelid taxa - an undivided oligochaete group (detritus feeders) and the leeches (Hirudinea, predators of worms, snails and insect larvae) - pooled here because each is a single source taxon of the same annelid grade.
